summary: The minimal construction reproduced the inflation deterministically. Before the sync node 5 reported accepted 3, decided 3, is_reconfigured Some, with the StopSign at index 2 and nothing at index 3. After an AcceptSync whose prefix already covered that position and which also carried the StopSign, it reported accepted 4, decided 3, is_reconfigured None, index 2 absent and index 3 a StopSign. The declared comparison is complete and violated. sync_log sets the accepted index to the covered prefix length and then adds one for the StopSign, so accepted lands one past the readable log, the marker is written at the inflated position and index 2 is left empty, while is_reconfigured turns None because decided 3 no longer equals accepted 4. This is precisely the shape seen in the seeded run, where nodes 1, 2 and 5 counted 38 positions with index 36 empty and the marker at 37, after which leader 4 decided 38 from reported accepted indices and node 3 clamped at 37 with no repair. The update records the four-message witness as a new fact, links it to the source arithmetic, the randomized ordering and the downstream decision, and restates the interpretation so the defect now rests on deterministic evidence as well as the seeded run. Counterevidence now notes that is_reconfigured alone is not a reliable signal of log contents. No execution is requested.
